title: VTM 1.2.6.0 - Release Notes
body_text: New Features Introduced Mono > Stereo compatibility (AAX and AU formats) Introduced Native support for Apple Silicon Bugs Fixed Unexpected noise/distortion when processing low frequencies Windows: Improved 2x rendering on 2k monitors Fixed a crash in case of a permission issue on the preset folder GarageBand: Fixed plugin instantiation Native Apple Silicon support for AAX plugin Format on macOS 2x support: Virtual Tape Machines scales with a factor 2 for all Windows scaling values above 150% Fixed Studio One AU automation issues during offline rendering Session loading and preset loading on Logic Pro & GarageBand x86 (Rosetta or Native Intel) should have been improved Known Issues Live only: VTM writes Bias Automation when copying/pasting audio clips Adobe Audition and VST3 only: GUI disorder when hiding Reels Nuendo only: Dynamic Stem crashes the DAW Opening the Settings Panel displays the Preset Modifier (*) Settings are hidden after close/open GUI Pro Tools only: Compare feature doesn't work when Default Groups is not "ungrouped" Pro Tools only: Toggle Parameters glitch when assigning VTM to a Group Mac and Live VST2 only: Switching Presets glitches audio WaveLab 8.5 and lower: Crash when trying to render a Mono file WaveLab and VST3 only: Reels rotation are not synchronized with Playback AU only: Resize triggers GUI blink Sequoia only: Show reels/settings crashes the DAW Shared Framework Changes Maschine and AU only: Fixed a crash when copying/pasting a new plugin instance with GUI open Shared Framework Fixes Text entry in MixCraft 7 doesn't work Shared Framework Improvements Better Plug-in Mappings for the Avid/Digidesign Control Surfaces Shared Framework Issues Windows and Reaper VST3 only: Plugin window overlaps Preset Bar | Workaround: Reopen the GUI. Windows and Reaper VST3 only: Full-speed Offline Renders don't read correctly the automation Pro Tools 12: Committing a track brings a Tail with Noisy Plugins Live and VST2 only: Occasional Presets and Snapsho
